correctness.rationale: Exactly enumerated 42 square tableaux; an exact integer Gram elimination computes ranks 1,11,31,41,42, independently checked by growth-of-shapes enumeration and modular elimination at three primes. The explicit 24-term sign alternant is annihilated by every event fixing at most three entries because one of its permutation blocks retains at least two free positions. Degree-three rank 41 proves uniqueness, and degree-four rank 42 proves recovery; a specified degree-four indicator has signed sum one, giving probability gap 1/12.

value.rationale: A canonical 42-state square-tableau family exhibits an exact order-four threshold for identifying arbitrary laws and a uniquely determined order-three blind signed measure. Its support factors into three incomparable-cell permutation blocks (2,3,2), yielding two explicit distinct 12-state distributions with equal three-entry marginals and a concrete four-entry separating event; the result is a motivated complete finite classification, not a numerical increment.
